title: Food court
content: Today I discovered there are other people going to what I thought was my alternative universe because I go to my mall world every night. My spawn point is usually in the hallway leading to the food court and the people I see here are usually from the past I never got closure from. The problem with the food court is that I can’t ever get food. Shops are always sold out. The place I want to eat is closed or suddenly changed to something else. If I do find something, I’ll walk to it but it gets further away so I don’t end up ever eating here. Does anyone have a food court?
